segments.text:
V. 64.
But there are ſome of you who believe not—And ſo receive no Life by them, becauſe you take them in a groſs literal Senſe. For Jeſus knew from the beginning—Of his Miniſtry: Who would betray him —Therefore it is plain, GOD does foreſee future Contingencies:
"But his Fore-knowledge cauſes not the Fault
"Which had no leſs prov'd certain unforeknown."
